magic_number = 9*8*7
div = 9876432.div(magic_number) * magic_number
candidates = div.step(0, -magic_number)

 res = candidates.find do |c|
  digits = c.digits
  (digits & [0,5]).empty? && digits == digits.uniq
end
 puts "Largest decimal number is #{res}"

def r_palindrome?(s)
  if s.length <= 1
    true
  elsif s[0] != s[-1]
    false
  else
    r_palindrome?(s[1..-2])
  end
end

def fib(n)
   if n < 2
     n
   else
     prev, fib = 0, 1
     (n-1).times do
       prev, fib = fib, fib + prev
     end
     fib
   end
 end

p (0..10).map { |i| fib(i) }
